notes.title: Kōmori Fruit Rush - Lunar Sale
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36104744/df892ab8e5e418482e1fa730aef5724f922d892a.png[/img]

The moon has decided to assist in providing you a opportunity to get your copy of Kōmori Fruit Rush at a 60% discount, during the SteamLunarSale ! 

Kȯmori is a Hyper-Casual object/fruit catching game with a few twists from the norm. It sets out to challenge all ages and will be able to challenge some of the most skilled individuals in their quest to be and stay the best.

Kids love Easy,Beginner and Medium difficulty , adults strive in Medium cringe on Hard and absolutely show off skill on Legend  difficulty.

The Easy difficultly has been designed to allow parents the relaxing thought that the game will not require their assistance as there toddler or a individual still learning how to use a mouse plays , as the player will not be able to be harmed in this difficulty.  


Quests :
Enjoy random generated quests to get the score flowing or keep the kids busy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36104744/8708787b3e2aa7b28c6f891d831b102765452c4e.png[/img]

Kōmori Rush :
Once specific requirement have been met , such as picking up 10 of the same fruit directly after each other or completing a quest with a reward for activating the rush, those who would want to harm Kōmori will slow down as he gets faster causing a Rush for the player (Our kids and friends kids love this) allowing the score to be affected vastly as the player catches fruit in during this time.

CLOSURE 

Join in the fun , or dominate the leader boards , the choice is yours ^^. 

Get your copy while you still can ! 

Want to pop the gamedevs a message ? Follow us on twitter , we love talking to players https://twitter.com/LoneRogueProdu1.
